name: vctrs
resume: 5 of 200 exports are checked. A wave is in translation: size, names, missing, repetition, sequences, dictionary and sets, order, subscript, atomic cast, and asserts. Data frames, dates, factors, list_of, dplyr and tibble methods, and integer64 stay untranslated.

functions.name: vec_recycle_common
functions.done: Recycle a length-1 vector to the common size.

proof.r:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(vctrs))
one <- function() {
  paste(unlist(vec_recycle_common(1, 1:3)), collapse = ",")
}
value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
shown <- enc2utf8(paste(as.character(value), collapse = "|"))
shown <- gsub("\n", " / ", shown, fixed = TRUE)
cat("VALUE ", shown, "\n", sep = "")
cat(sprintf("MS %.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))

functions.name: list_unchop
functions.done: Concatenate vectors, or place them at 1-based indices.

check.case: concatenated pieces, then pieces placed by index

proof.r:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(vctrs))
one <- function() {
  paste(paste(list_unchop(list(1:2, 3:4)), collapse = ","), paste(list_unchop(list(1, 2:3), indices = list(c(1, 3, 5), c(2, 4))), collapse = ","), sep = "/")
}
value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
shown <- enc2utf8(paste(as.character(value), collapse = "|"))
shown <- gsub("\n", " / ", shown, fixed = TRUE)
cat("VALUE ", shown, "\n", sep = "")
cat(sprintf("MS %.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))
proof.python:
import statistics
import time
from vctrs import list_unchop

def one():
    left = ",".join(str(item) for item in list_unchop([[1, 2], [3, 4]]))
    right = ",".join(str(item) for item in list_unchop([1, [2, 3]], indices=[[1, 3, 5], [2, 4]]))
    return left + "/" + right

value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
if isinstance(value, bool):
    shown = "TRUE" if value else "FALSE"
elif value is None:
    shown = "NULL"
else:
    shown = str(value).replace("\n", " / ")
print("VALUE " + shown)
print(f"MS {statistics.median(elapsed):.17g}")
